name: Checkmarx One
covers: Projects, scans and scan results statistics
credentialNote: The API key is a refresh token. toil exchanges it at your region's IAM host (eu.iam.checkmarx.net for eu.ast.checkmarx.net) for a short-lived bearer token, kept in memory and never written to disk. Client credentials (a client ID and secret) aren't supported

supported.note: Checkmarx One is cloud only, so there is no server release to pin. toil calls its REST API under /api with a bearer token exchanged from an API key.
